2115467549840449642.en_summary: $VRT earnings just answered one of the biggest questions around the AI Power trade by showing that massive infrastructure demand is translating into real revenue, higher margins and actual cash flow. With Vertiv expanding into site-level power through UIG while moving closer to the chip with advanced cooling, every AI data center buildout could bring more equipment revenue upfront and recurring service revenue afterward.
2115467549840449642.zh_summary: $VRT 財報剛剛回答了 AI 電力交易最大問題之一，顯示龐大基礎設施需求正轉化為真實營收、更高利潤率與實際現金流。隨著 Vertiv 透過 UIG 擴展至站點級電力，同時以先進冷卻更靠近晶片，每個 AI 數據中心建設都可能帶來前期更多設備營收與後續經常性服務營收。

ticker_notes.VRT: AI 基礎設施需求轉化為營收、利潤與現金流，擴展電力與冷卻業務

2115467180938846505.en_summary: Back in September when $VIX was around 14, said prepare for a VIX spike to 21.46 minimum in October; hit as high as 22.31. For November, likely see a smashed VIX. Since 2018, November saw the month red 7 of 8 times, and 6 of those 7 were pretty crushed to close the month.
2115467180938846505.zh_summary: 9 月當 $VIX 約 14 時曾說準備 10 月 VIX 至少衝至 21.46，結果最高達 22.31。對 11 月，很可能看到 VIX 被大幅壓低。自 2018 年以來，11 月有 8 次中的 7 次當月收跌，其中 6 次跌幅相當可觀。

2115467064106205212.en_summary: Getting more concerned about $GOOG because they need an answer to personalized bots. Three key topics for earnings tonight: 1. Cloud growth outlook. Expect 92% growth in September and 95% in December, think they guide to slight step-up in December. 2. Capex. Street at $201B in CY26 and $312B in CY27, think that's right. 3. How do they win with personalized bots? Can Google have AI Overview and AI Mode encore to direct search traffic into personalized bot usage?
2115467064106205212.zh_summary: 對 $GOOG 愈來愈擔憂，因為他們需要應對個人化機器人。今晚財報三大主題：1. 雲端增長展望。預期 9 月增長 92%、12 月 95%，認為會指引 12 月略為加速。2. 資本支出。街預期 CY26 為 2010 億美元、CY27 為 3120 億美元，認為正確。3. 如何以個人化機器人取勝？Google 能否以 AI Overview 與 AI Mode 將搜尋流量導向個人化機器人使用？

ticker_notes.GOOG: 需解決個人化機器人挑戰，雲端增長與資本支出為關注點
